title.ko: in order to · so that · provided that · as long as · unless · otherwise
title.en: in order to · so that · provided that · as long as · unless · otherwise

explain.ko: 목적과 조건을 나타내는 연결어도 뒤에 오는 구조가 다릅니다. in order to와 so as to 뒤에는 동사원형이 오고(I went early in order to buy a ticket), so that 뒤에는 절이 오며 조동사 can, could, will, would를 함께 씁니다. 조건은 as long as, provided that, on condition that으로 나타내며 ‘~하는 한’이라는 제한을 뜻합니다. unless는 if … not과 같은 뜻이고 부정문을 따로 쓰지 않습니다. otherwise는 ‘그렇지 않으면’이라는 뜻의 부사로 앞 내용을 조건으로 삼습니다. in case는 ‘만일의 경우에 대비해’라는 뜻으로 if와 구별해야 합니다.
explain.en: Purpose and condition linkers take different structures. In order to and so as to take a base verb (I went early in order to buy a ticket); so that takes a clause with can, could, will or would. Conditions use as long as, provided that and on condition that, meaning 'only if'. Unless means if … not, and the clause itself is positive. Otherwise is an adverb meaning 'if not'. In case means 'as a precaution' and differs from if.

task.model: I work part-time at weekends in order to save money for my trip. My parents allowed it as long as I keep up my grades. I also bought a raincoat in case it rains. Unless I hurry, the tickets will sell out.

model_trans.en: I work part-time at weekends in order to save money for my trip. My parents allowed it as long as I keep up my grades. I also bought a raincoat in case it rains. Unless I hurry, the tickets will sell out.
